doc.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

title: Eastman prep program and bass lessons with Oscar Zimmerman
summary: He studied theory and bass with Zimmerman, Ron Carter's teacher, on Saturdays for two years.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Well I did go to Eastman in the prep program.

In that program I just had theory class and lessons, two hours every Saturday, so that was for two years. So I probably went there a hundred times — well no, school year is probably less than that, probably eighty times or something for lessons. I had lessons with Oscar Zimmerman, the principal bassist for the Rochester Philharmonic and also the teacher of Ron Carter among others. I think me and Ron are the only ones really—
Did you have any desire to go to Eastman?
Well to get musical education however I could get it, sure. Absolutely. But Zimmerman was the cat. He was the cat to go to if you were going to take bass lessons. I’m sorry, go ahead.
